key_material_policy: Committed JSON contains public corpus material and mutation recipes only. Deterministic B2-E/B2-F private fixture seeds exist only inside the checker.
honest_boundary: The two positive compositions are rebuilt and signed at gate runtime, then serialized, independently parsed again, and verified; they are not accepted from JSON summaries.
The gate separately consumes the committed B2-B/C/E raw bytes rather than trusting their decoded JSON fields or claimed digest/power summaries.
Successful verification authorizes only the exact field-1..11 joint handoff composition. It emits no aggregate digest and no EpochAnchorQC.
Upgrade field 12, first-new-epoch proposal field 13, new-epoch finality field 14, and every application/governance/provenance obligation listed by the logical schema remain open.
